tour.welcome.title: Hello! 👋
tour.welcome.text:
Welcome to TopLista.mk!

Would you like a quick tour of the site? It takes about 2 minutes and will show you what the site offers — charts, artists, events, and much more.

You can also start it later from ⚙ Settings.
tour.step0.title: Hello! 👋
tour.step0.text:
Welcome to TopLista.mk!

This is a site for anyone who loves Macedonian music — we track artists, rank songs, collect events and news, and much more.

Let's see what the site has to offer. The tour takes about 2 minutes.
tour.step1.title: Navigation
tour.step1.text:
This is the navigation. From here you can reach everything: charts, master list, events, news, and more.

On mobile, tap the logo in the top left to open the menu — there's also a "Home" button for quick access to the main page.
tour.step2.title: Settings ⚙
tour.step2.text:
In settings you can change a few things:

• Theme — light or dark, whatever you prefer
• Streaming service — choose yours (Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music…)

When you click a song on the site, it will open directly in the service you chose.

⚙ Settings are in the top bar — just scroll up to find them next to the logo.
tour.step3.title: Home page 🏠
tour.step3.text:
This is the dashboard — an overview of everything happening on the site.

Here you can see the most played songs, new releases, upcoming events, news, curator picks, and more — all in one place.
tour.step4.title: Quick actions ⚡
tour.step4.text:
These buttons are shortcuts to the most useful features:

• Surprise me — random artist
• Add artist — suggest someone who's missing
• Add event — report a concert or festival
• Become a curator — share your playlist

Just one click.
tour.step5.title: Charts 📊
tour.step5.text:
This is the heart of the site — the Charts.

Here the most listened releases (songs, albums, EPs) by Macedonian artists are ranked. Ranking is based on Spotify play counts.

Data is refreshed daily, and a new chart is calculated every Monday. Every past chart is saved in the archive.
tour.step6.title: Filters
tour.step6.text:
There isn't just one chart — there are several variants:

• Charts — all songs available on Spotify from artists in the Master List
• Alternative — all non-pop songs
• All time — cumulative artist list by followers

You can also combine filters for more specific results.
tour.step7.title: Sections
tour.step7.text:
The chart is divided into three sections:

• Singles — individual songs
• Albums — albums and EPs
• New releases — songs released in the last 30 days

Each section can be shared separately.
tour.step8.title: Master List 📋
tour.step8.text:
This is the Master List — the main database of the site.

Here all Macedonian artists and bands are collected, along with their genres, cities, profile links and more. Practically every other function on the site (charts, news, events) depends on this list.
tour.step9.title: Search and filter
tour.step9.text:
You can search by name, genre, city or combine filters for a more precise result.

Feel free to type in Cyrillic or Latin — both work. For example, typing "rok" will show you all rock artists.
tour.step10.title: Add artist ➕
tour.step10.text:
Notice that an artist or band is missing? You can suggest them here!

Click the button, fill in the form with basic info (name, genre, links) and submit. After a quick review from our side, the artist will appear on the site.
tour.step11.title: Events 📅
tour.step11.text:
Here we collect upcoming concerts, festivals, and music events across Macedonia.

Know about an event that's not here? Click "Add event" and fill in the details. Once we verify it — we'll add it. Anyone can contribute!
tour.step12.title: News 📰
tour.step12.text:
Here you'll find news and articles about the Macedonian music scene from various online media.

The special thing is that the news isn't random — only articles that mention an artist already in the Master List are shown. This way you get only relevant news about local musicians.
tour.step13.title: Curators 🎧
tour.step13.text:
Curators are people who manually compile playlists with any kind of music and share them here.

Each curator has their own taste and style. If you also have a playlist that you keep updated — you can apply to become a curator. You don't have to be an artist, you just have to be a passionate music critic.
tour.step14.title: Surprise me 🎲
tour.step14.text:
Don't know what to listen to? No problem.

Choose a genre and time period, click the button and the site will pick a random artist for you. A great way to discover something new, or to be reminded of something forgotten.
tour.step15.title: That's all! 🎸
tour.step15.text:
Thanks for taking the tour! If you like the idea, here are a few ways you can contribute:

• Add an artist who's not in the Master List
• Add an event for an upcoming concert
• Become a curator and share your playlist
• Verify your band if you're an artist
• Say hi on Xotel Discord for ideas, feedback, or just to say hello

You can repeat the tour anytime — open ⚙ Settings and click "Site tour".

Enjoy! 🙌

about.metaDesc: Information about TopLista.mk — project, purpose, license and contact.
about.intro1: TopLista.mk is a Macedonian music chart based on YouTube views, plus an open database of Macedonian artists and bands.
about.intro2: Built by the Xotel community. Open to contributions.
about.masterList1: The database is a manually compiled list of Macedonian music artists. Each entry includes: name, city, genre, streaming and social media links, and activity status.
about.masterList2: Anyone can suggest changes through the form on the site. Changes go to GitHub and get published after review by Martin.
about.masterList3: Activity status is automatic — "Active" if there's a release in the last 2 years, "Maybe" for 2–3 years, or "Inactive" if nothing for over 3 years.
about.criteria1: The artist needs some proof of existence — music on streaming platforms, published articles, gig posters, or confirmation from the members themselves.
about.criteria2: They also need at least one original song. Cover bands are not accepted.
about.formatName: Name: In Cyrillic and Macedonian, unless the name is in another language (e.g. English).
about.formatCity: City: City of origin of any member — not where they live now.
about.formatSoundsLike: Sounds like: An obvious influence, or mentioned in an interview/bio.
about.formatYouTube: YouTube: Channel over individual links when possible. Must be the artist's own channel, not a label.
about.verify1: If you're an artist on the list and want to verify your profile — click "Verified", pick your colors, and we'll contact you through your official pages.
about.chart1: The chart is based on YouTube views. For each release, we track how many views it got this week compared to last week.
about.chartSingles: Singles — Last 20 singles from the past 4 weeks, ranked by weekly YouTube views. Spotify counts releases with 1–4 tracks as singles.
about.chartAlbums: Albums — Last 20 albums from the past 8 weeks, same principle.
about.chartLimit: Limit — Max 2 releases per artist on the chart.
about.chartAllTime: All time — Top 100 artists by Spotify follower count.
about.updates1: The chart locks every Monday. Changes (up/down arrows) are compared to the previous Monday.
about.updates2: If we change the algorithm, results might take a week or two to settle.
about.releases1: To be on the chart, a release must be on Spotify — that's where we get the metadata (name, date, type).
about.releases2: Each song can have multiple YouTube videos. The week-over-week view difference determines the ranking.
about.videoLiveNote: Only if it captures the full song and does not contain other songs
about.videoFullAlbumNote: Added to the first song of the release and counted towards it
about.videoCoverNote: Not accepted (unless by the original artist)
about.videoCriteria2: In short: If the artist performs the song in the video — it counts. Covers, reactions, and reviews — no.
about.chartGen1: The chart is generated exclusively based on YouTube views. For each release, the system calculates the difference in YouTube views between the current and previous week (view delta). This difference is normalized to a scale of 0 to 100 and used for ranking. YouTube was chosen as the sole source because it is the most popular platform for listening to music in Macedonia, and best reflects the real popularity of songs.
about.chartGen2: Releases are grouped by type — singles and albums are ranked separately. Each artist can have at most 2 releases on the chart at the same time. The chart is anchored once a week, every Monday.
about.chartGen3: Important: This system is subject to change. The ranking algorithms, data sources, and inclusion criteria may change over time to improve the accuracy and quality of the chart.
about.chartGen4: YouTube views can be inflated artificially (ads, bought views). That's not against the rules, but it's pretty obvious when it happens.
about.popTag1: Artists tagged "pop" don't appear on the alternative chart.
about.popTag2: They're still visible on the main chart and the artist database.
about.news1: The news page pulls from Macedonian media (mono-ton, Kultura Beta, Popup Mk, MK Tickets, Sloboden Pechat, Nova Makedonija, A1on, Meta.mk, MKD.MK, Libertas, 360 Stepeni, Radio MOF, Fokus, Netpres). Got a source to suggest? Hit us up on Discord.
about.news2: Only articles that mention an artist from the database are shown.
about.news3: Articles are stored in an open archive (articles.json) that is updated daily.
about.events1: Anyone can submit an event, but it goes through manual review first — same as artist changes.
about.curator1: Algorithms can recommend music, but they can't replace the taste of someone who actually knows the scene.
about.curator2: A curator is someone who manually puts together a playlist and shares it with the community. Real recommendations instead of algorithms.
about.curator3: To become a curator, you need to be connected to the music scene somehow — artist, critic, radio host, blogger, or similar.
about.curator4: If you want to become a curator, join the Xotel Discord server and reach out.
about.code1: The code is open and available on GitHub.
about.code2: The site is static (HTML/CSS/JS), hosted on GitHub Pages. Most of the code is AI-generated, but the data is 100% manually entered and verified.
about.tech1: The site is static (HTML/CSS/JS), hosted on GitHub Pages. Data is stored in JSON format on GitHub and is open. Streaming data comes from the Spotify API.
about.license1: Artist and article data is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0). Free to use, share and adapt as long as you credit the source.
about.contact1: For questions, suggestions or bug reports — Xotel Discord.
about.contact2: The site is currently maintained by Martin, with huge thanks to Tomi, Antonio (Matsik), Harun, Sasho, Petar, Andrej, Irena, Daniel, Mirche, Marko, Boshko, Stefan, Filip x2, the entire Xotel community and a bunch of other unsung heroes who helped in one way or another. Created with pride in the Republic of Macedonia.
